definitions.name: Localization: visit → transcription → result by language
definitions.description: Rolling 28 days; unique people; ordered steps within 1 day; language attributed at first pageview. Detected bots excluded at entry. Language is not country. Missing historical language is unassigned. Drop-off identifies friction, not proof of bad translation.

definitions.name: Localization: file upload funnel by language
definitions.description: Rolling28days, ordered within1day. Visit → upload_selected → transcription_started → succeeded. Audio-upload path only; excludes YouTube-only use. Entry language; detected bots excluded at entry. Signup/limits can interrupt this path.

definitions.name: Localization: signup path by language
definitions.description: Rolling28days, unique people, ordered within1day: visit → signup_started → signup_completed → transcription_started. Entry language; excludes detected bots at entry. Returning signed-in users need not follow this path. Small cohorts require caution.

definitions.name: Localization: page → transcription → result
definitions.description: Rolling28days; unique people; ordered within1day; breakdown at pageview pathname. One person may enter multiple page cohorts; rows cannot be summed. Includes editor pages where transcription may not be intended. Use matched page types and traffic sources.
